## Goal
Find **published** benchmark results for **The Stack v2**.

- Only use results stated on a public page you can quote verbatim.
- Quote 20–600 characters that contain the value.
- If nothing exists, submit `no_results_found: true` with the URLs you searched.

Start from https://huggingface.co/datasets/bigcode/the-stack-v2
